_comment: Phase 2D.3 QR-DQN under act-v3 — Stage A, from scratch, 1,996,800 decisions (166,400 cycles x 12 environments), one gradient update per cycle once the replay holds 10,000 transitions. 32 fixed quantiles tau_i = (i - 0.5)/32, quantile-Huber kappa 1 (mean over 32x32 pairs), Double-DQN target on the masked mean, priority mean_j |y_j - theta_j| + 1e-6. n = 16, gamma = 1, PER (alpha 0.6, beta 0.4 -> 1.0 over the budget, capacity 500,000), batch 256, Adam 3e-4 / eps 1e-5, clip 0.5, hard target copy every 2,500 updates, epsilon 1.0 -> 0.05 over the first 1,000,000 decisions. Validation (epsilon 0, masked mean-quantile argmax) at the eight PPO/A2C/D3QN checkpoints. Hard stop unless the action spec is act-v3 5f72f510c48b1f46.
